NDC-2787 retest: draft comment

9 Nov 2026 · NDC-Staging · read-only · Lane A
Not posted. This is a draft for review. Nothing was sent to Plane. 3 built, 2 partly built, 10 still missing.

Comment as it would appear

Retest 9 Nov 2026 on NDC-Staging (read-only). Of the 15 items: 3 built, 2 partly built, 10 still missing.

Built

  • M-06 Dashboards and reports: Desk → Analytics now opens Dashboards (Overview, SLA, Ticket Status, Customer Happiness, Add Dashboard) and Reports (Add Report, Global, Static). On 2 Nov both went to Headquarters.
  • M-07 Blueprint: all listed defects (NDC-2754..2758, 2761..2764, 2774, 2775) are Done.
  • M-09 Layout rules and validation: NDC-2230 and NDC-2231 Done; the 3 Nov rebuild worked. NDC-2535 is still open as a gap list.

Partly built

  • M-08 Round robin: load, sequential, skill and team targets exist, and "Mark idle agents offline" (1–120 min) is new. Criteria have Is Overdue and SLA Escalated, but not Is Response Overdue or Layout. NDC-2275 is still Bug.
  • M-12 Arabic and translation: the Help Center can show English and Arabic. Article translation, machine translation and more languages are "Coming soon"; tickets have no Translate.

Still missing

  • M-01 Live chat, M-02 WhatsApp / IM: no channel in Setup; the Chat and Social pages say "In Development".
  • M-04 AI: the ticket now has an AI assist panel, but Summarize and Suggest triage return 404 ("Something went wrong"). No AI workflow action.
  • M-05 Agent scale: GET /iam/users still returns the same 200 rows whatever page, size, offset or search is sent. The bug is still not filed.
  • M-10 Attachment limits: no size, count or file-type setting.
  • M-11 Extensions, M-13 Gamescope, M-14 Remote support, M-15 Zoho Cliq: not in TAVI.
  • M-16 Anonymised contacts: Data Retention (auto-delete with legal holds) is new, but there is no anonymise or data subject request flow.

Related tickets: NDC-2791, 2792, 2793, 2795, 2797, 2798 Done; NDC-2794 and NDC-2796 In Progress.

Evidence: 01-channels-addons, 02-ai, 03-agent-scale, 04-attachments-privacy, 05-translation, 06-remote-cliq (TAVI left, NDC Zoho right).
